name: Dogfood 037: RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness for cross-repo workflows

native_delegation.instruction: Use native delegation aggressively for parallelizable work that meets the criteria in the implement prompt. The parent session remains accountable for Striatum artifacts, write scope, verification, and completion. Long-running `make test` invocations should be reasonably bounded — break large test files into smaller verifications if the run risks lease expiry beyond the documented ~30-minute window.
Use sub-agents aggressively for bounded independent research, review, and code/test/doc authorship. Do not let native delegation obscure the parent session's artifact and verdict accountability.

Use local sub-agents only for bounded independent work. Do not rely on remote agent-to-agent delegation or hidden state as provenance. When asked to write a review artifact, write the file directly; do not surface strategy and exit without producing the artifact (see dogfood-036 OPERATOR_REPORT.md for the friction pattern this constraint addresses). When writing finding artifacts, use the EXACT `striatum.finding.v1` front-matter shape: `verdict_intent` (not `verdict`); `severity` from {low,medium,high,critical} (not `none`); `tags` as a JSON array; the `author: ...` byline is a plain markdown line AFTER the front-matter block, not a key inside it.

jobs.title: Design RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness from Codex
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0035: the `tests/_harness/MultiRepoHarness` fixture + five end-to-end test files (prepare/lifecycle/crash-recovery/MCP-capability-scope/per-repo-write-scope). Cover: harness module layout (`tests/_harness/{__init__.py, multi_repo.py, daemon.py, repos.py, pg.py, mcp.py}`), `MultiRepoHarness.start()` / `.stop()` / `.reset_daemon_db()` lifecycle, ephemeral Postgres database creation against the existing system PG (RFC 0033 substrate), daemon subprocess boot with ephemeral Unix socket, per-test repo init + register, per-test database reset semantics, the five e2e test files' coverage matrices, CI integration (`make test-multi-repo`, skip-with-message when PG unavailable), and the harness smoke test (`tests/test_multi_repo_harness.py`). Scope is developer/test infrastructure — no product code, no public API.

jobs.title: Design RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness from Claude Code
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0035 emphasizing trust boundaries the e2e tests will exercise: capability scope mismatch (token scoped to repo A used against repo B), `tools/list` capability-filtering correctness, default-deny on unknown methods, audit chain integrity across allow/deny paths, crash recovery (daemon SIGKILL mid-prepare/start/cancel), per-repo write-scope enforcement (job targeting repo B refused from writing repo A's paths), one-repo-unreachable-mid-run pause + human checkpoint. Be specific about how the harness simulates these without leaving residue between test runs (per-test DB reset semantics).

jobs.title: Design RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness from Gemini
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0035 with attention to cross-platform reality (Linux + macOS PG, no Windows daemon), CI matrix integration (existing PG-extras jobs + macOS-no-PG skip path), wall-clock budget (< 60s added to local `make test`), determinism + cleanup hygiene (ephemeral DB dropped, scratch dir removed, Unix socket deleted on stop), port/socket collision avoidance (subprocess + Unix socket so no port conflicts), and how the harness exposes assertion helpers for daemon-DB row inspection + per-repo SQLite row inspection.

jobs.title: Synthesize RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness implementation plan
jobs.objective: Reconcile all three fresh design artifacts into one implementation plan for RFC 0035. Pick the concrete harness module layout, `MultiRepoHarness` API shape, per-test DB reset semantics, fixture scope (per-class default + per-function escape hatch), the five e2e test files' exact case lists, CI integration shape, and `make test-multi-repo` recipe. Explicitly defer: a Go-client testing surface (RFC 0035 §Open Questions; D084 future); the two-repos-with-worktree-isolated-lanes example workflow (follow-up). State the staging plan: harness skeleton + smoke test first, then prepare + lifecycle e2e, then crash recovery e2e, then MCP capability scope e2e, then per-repo write-scope e2e, then CI wiring + docs.

jobs.title: Threat-model review of RFC 0035 design
jobs.objective: Review the synthesized multi-repo test harness plan under threat_model posture. Verdict acceptance means the harness will actually exercise the threat surfaces RFC 0032 V2 introduced: capability scope mismatch refused with `capability_missing` and audited; default-deny on unknown methods + missing capability; audit chain integrity across allow/deny paths; daemon-crash reconciliation (preparing → started or aborted); one-repo-unreachable pause + human checkpoint; per-repo write-scope enforcement. Scope per RFC 0031 §Threat Model: defend against over-eager AI agents acting through documented interfaces and operator-mistake footguns; malicious-local-root is OUT OF SCOPE. Also check: deterministic cleanup hygiene (no residue between tests), no flaky-on-CI patterns (subprocess + Unix socket means no port conflicts), and that the harness does NOT introduce a parallel production-code path. IMPORTANT — write the REVIEW.md artifact directly in this single supervised invocation. Use the EXACT `striatum.finding.v1` front-matter shape: `verdict_intent` (not `verdict`); `severity` from {low,medium,high,critical}; `tags` as a JSON array; the `author: <slug>` byline is a plain markdown line AFTER the front-matter block, NOT a key inside it.

jobs.title: Implement RFC 0035 multi-repo test harness V1
jobs.objective: Implement only the reviewed and accepted V1 slice from docs/dogfood/037/DESIGN_SYNTHESIS.md. Ship the `tests/_harness/` module skeleton + `MultiRepoHarness` fixture, ephemeral Postgres + daemon boot/teardown, per-test DB reset semantics, the harness smoke test, the five end-to-end test files, `make test-multi-repo` target, and `tests/conftest.py` integration. Use sub-agents aggressively for parallelizable work. Document deferred scope (Go-client testing surface, example workflow) in BUILD_HANDOFF.md. Cycle exhaustion at max_iterations=2 → operator records a decision artifact and continues with the latest verdict.

jobs.title: Threat-model review of RFC 0035 V1 build
jobs.objective: Review the implementation under threat_model posture. Verify: every e2e test file exercises the threat surfaces it claims (read each test's assertions); the harness smoke test exercises the actual lifecycle (start → register → reset → stop); per-test DB reset truncates the right tables (audit chain rows must be cleared cleanly between tests); ephemeral Postgres + daemon scratch dir are deterministically cleaned up; `make test-multi-repo` correctly skips when PG is unavailable with a clear message; no flaky-on-CI patterns; the harness does NOT introduce a parallel production-code path. Tests cover happy + denial + revoked + expired + scope-mismatch + unknown-method paths.
